svg.title: Architecture of janith.qzz.io
svg.desc: janiyax35.github.io (git · main branch) -> GitHub Actions (static.yml · deploy) -> GitHub Pages (janith.qzz.io · HTTPS) -> browser (index.html home; lab.html the lab; data.js -> render; localStorage: mode, flags). The browser loads only from the CSP allow-list: Google Fonts (stylesheet + woff2); cdnjs · jsDelivr · unpkg (pinned versions · SRI sha384); world-atlas 2.0.2 (globe data · hash-checked); EmailJS API (contact form · rate-limited). Static site: no server code and no build step. The browser only talks to hosts on the CSP allow-list.
svg.text: Static site: no server code and no build step. The browser only talks to hosts on the CSP allow-list.
